metadata.description: Claude Code mods for long sessions: a context usage meter, an automatic handoff-and-compact cycle, and prompt timestamps.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Shows context-window usage and five-hour and weekly limit usage in the prompt footer

plugins.name: context-handoff
plugins.description: In the 60-70% context band, Claude writes a handoff, the handoff is rewound away, the session compacts, and Claude resumes from the file.

plugins.name: prompt-timestamp
plugins.description: Prefixes every prompt you type with the local date and time, visible to you and Claude.
